summary.name: Stained-Glass Light Projection
summary.visualIdentity: Jewel-colored glass panes divided by dark leading project one image onto a cool, dim stone room, turning the space into colored transmitted light. The window frame and mullions occlude the light coherently. Explicit: this is a projected-texture approximation, not physical refraction or caustics.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit scope: dim architectural space that shifts into colored projected light, ending in a white bloom finale. Inferred suitability: dramatic reveals, title moments or atmospheric architectural staging. Other subjects, settings and copy are unspecified and need task confirmation.
summary.limitations: Explicit: the projection is an approximation with softness and resolution that need tuning. Bloom is limited to the source finale. Physical transmission and caustics are not claimed. The reference poster verifies only one dark-opening frame, not full-video scenes. Fallback to Remotion requires a recorded reason.
summary.palette: Authored fallback tokens, not approved exact colors: background #101216 (scene-dependent), foreground #F4EEE3, ruby #A82E43, sapphire #284A9D, gold #D6AD52. Deep blue belongs to the glass, not the whole room, and panes must not render gray. Foreground on background measures 16.235:1. No gradient is enabled. The contrast check excludes transmitted light and textures, so composited frames must be verified. Task-provided exact colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit sequence: dim stone, then blackout to zero light, then spotlight intensity and angle sweep moving the pattern across the floor, then a white bloom and light ramp finale. The three-second preview runs dim, blackout and colored projection. Camera moves appear only in the full video. Pointer interaction for HTML is unspecified; motion must be a pure function of composition time.
summary.audio: Source gives no audio requirement; direction is an open choice per topic and audience. Options include music, voiceover, sung vocals, effects, ambience or silence. Inferred fit: sparse ambience or music that rises with the light, with silence at blackout. Any speech must stay intelligible. No audio assets are supplied, and none should be claimed unless created or authorized.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploaded assets are required. The stained-glass image is painted procedurally with Canvas 2D, and stone grain is procedural. Explicit placeholders such as subject, copy, duration, aspect ratio, resolution, frame rate and output directory are unspecified. Fonts and any local assets must load before rendering. No motion references are selected.
summary.combinations: The only authored supporting suggestion is style-079 for architectural staging within the primary scene. Style-126 stays dominant. Do not import the supporting palette, replace the verified background, or add competing full-scene treatments. For reduced-motion HTML, the secondary motion should be optional.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Three.js with MeshStandardMaterial and one Canvas 2D texture used as window emissive and SpotLight.map, plus EffectComposer passes (RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass at zero until finale, OutputPass). Motion engine: a paused GSAP timeline with time-pure values. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with Remotion only under its documented fallback condition. Validate with check, snapshot and render, then review decoded frames.
